rules.executor-must-1: Looser reading chosen by the user: met when a source shows the product writes to network devices over at least one of SSH/CLI, NETCONF, gNMI/gNOI or device REST APIs; partly met when no protocol is named, or it writes only to cloud APIs or to DNS/DHCP servers.
rules.collector-must-1: Looser reading chosen by the user: met when the product reads live data from network devices and also collects metrics (SNMP or streaming telemetry), logs (Syslog), flows, packets or traces; partly met when it reads only configuration or state, or covers only one narrow kind of device.
